post.summary: Durably accept an app-specific private offer
post.description: Private service route only; no public Nginx exposure, wildcard CORS or browser use. Credentials/internal origin stay on servers. Origin/Cookie and browser fetch context are rejected; only a lone Node-generated Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors is permitted without other browser metadata. Responses are no-store. Atomic enquiry/receipt/outbox commit precedes 202. Same app/requestId/normalized content with a correctly signed/bound token returns the same reference after a lost response or expired token. The original issue-hour bucket remains required; if address/key changes, obtain a fresh challenge with the same requestId and unchanged business payload. Changed content is 409; deleted enquiry is 410. Retention remains original 90 days.

ContactApplication.description: Canonical published portfolio ID. A private-deployment product may be selected as an enquiry topic; no private application URL is supplied.

clientBucket.description: Relay-derived hourly purpose-scoped HMAC-SHA256; never supplied by the browser. Not persisted or logged.

PartnershipChallengeRequest.description: Strict JSON/UTF-8, maximum 16384 bytes, no compression. App identity is derived only from the server key; no appId or privacyVersion field is accepted here.

PartnershipChallenge.description: App/request/bucket/locale/notice-bound token with 600000 ms TTL. Payload carries issuedAt but no bucket; relay uses the original issue hour also for retained expired-token retry (non-future, at most 90 days old). VCode verifies the signature/bindings; only a retained receipt may ignore expiry. Preparation alone does not enable challenges.

clientBucket.description: Relay-derived hourly purpose-scoped HMAC-SHA256; never supplied by the browser. Not persisted or logged.

type.description: Exact per-app approved registry whitelist; not free text. Moje porce uses vyrobce, obchod, autor-receptu, jine.

website.description: Empty honeypot; not a website URL.

PartnershipSubmission.description: NFC and CRLF-normalized Unicode lengths, trim and control-character rejection. No phone, attachments, app/domain/account/source fields. The selected type and notice version must match the authenticated app registry.

examples.name: Synthetic Partner
examples.message: Synthetic partnership offer for isolated testing only.

PartnershipReceipt.description: 202 only after enquiry, idempotency receipt and Telegram outbox commit. Identical retry returns the same reference without another message or job.

message.description: Fixed safe text; never field values, contacts, message contents, keys, IP, internal URL or dependency errors.

PartnershipError.description: Validated request UUID or null when absent/invalid. No additional fields.

PartnershipAudit.description: No previous message, contact or next-action text values. Expires with the enquiry.

type.description: Exact per-app approved registry whitelist; not free text. Moje porce uses vyrobce, obchod, autor-receptu, jine.

nextAction.description: Single line, trimmed and NFC normalized; no control characters or line breaks.

PartnershipInquiry.description: Private owner-only record. Expiry is exactly 90 days from original receipt; workflow/retry/promotion do not extend it. Only the most recent 200 audit entries are returned. No key/token/hash/bucket fields.

nextAction.description: Single line, trimmed and NFC normalized; no control characters or line breaks.

PartnershipWorkflowUpdate.description: At least one editable field is required. Manager must be the configured owner or null. Due date must be strictly before original expiry. A stale expectedVersion returns 409 without changing data.

PartnershipDeletionReceipt.description: Enquiry deletion removes content/audit/outbox, leaving only a minimal non-contact idempotency tombstone until original expiry. Partner deletion removes its separate record.

items.description: Exact per-app approved registry whitelist; not free text. Moje porce uses vyrobce, obchod, autor-receptu, jine.

PartnershipInbox.description: Counts reflect retained records matching app/stage filters, independently of item limit; deletion/expiry lower them. They are not people, lifetime totals or conversion rates. Only approved policies appear in promotionEnabled.

PartnershipPromotion.description: Explicit owner action requiring a separately approved, published, enabled per-app partner policy. Does not copy contact/message data or authorize contracts, licences or imports.

type.description: Exact per-app approved registry whitelist; not free text. Moje porce uses vyrobce, obchod, autor-receptu, jine.

PartnershipPartner.description: Independent minimal partner record, default disabled. Approved expiry is bounded to 1–365 days from creation; no email/message/full enquiry, internal source ID or indefinite retention.

PartnershipInvalidInput.description: Strict input, parameter, normalization or privacy-version validation failed. Codes invalid-input or privacy-version-mismatch.

PartnershipUnauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, disabled or revoked server credential, or no current authenticated dashboard session. Code unauthorized.

PartnershipRejected.description: Challenge, delay, bucket/locale binding, honeypot, same-origin or owner permission failed; promotion policy is not enabled. Code rejected.

PartnershipNotFound.description: Unknown route or missing/expired enquiry/partner; no private object details. Code not-found.

PartnershipMethodNotAllowed.description: This route does not accept the request method. Code method-not-allowed.

PartnershipConflict.description: Changed normalized submission under the same app/requestId, stale workflow version or duplicate promotion. Code idempotency-conflict.

PartnershipRequestClosed.description: The original enquiry was deleted; its minimal idempotency tombstone prevents resurrection until original expiry. Code request-closed.

PartnershipTooLarge.description: Request exceeds the 16384-byte uncompressed JSON limit. Code too-large.

PartnershipInvalidContentType.description: Use application/json with optional charset=utf-8 and no compressed content. Code invalid-content-type.

PartnershipRateLimit.description: Bounded challenge/submission or persistent daily capacity reached. Code rate-limit.

PartnershipUnavailable.description: Feature, registry, notice approvals or dependency are not ready. No fallback to another app or processing version. Code unavailable.

partnershipApplicationKey.description: Distinct revocable send-only application-server key, never a browser credential. Maps to one enabled catalogued application in the private registry. No real secret examples.

partnershipInboxService.description: Existing private contact inbox service credential, plus required freshly verified X-VCode-Admin-Id. Not an app key or public login. Service also verifies the configured owner ID.
